title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to -90.0, 0.0, -90.0 and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0. Begin by drawing a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0339, 0.0), then continue with a line from (0.0339, 0.0) to (0.0339, 0.0339). Next, draw a line from (0.0339, 0.0339) to (0.0319, 0.0339), followed by a line from (0.0319, 0.0339) to (0.0319, 0.002). Continue with a line from (0.0319, 0.002) to (0.0, 0.002) and conclude with a line from (0.0, 0.002) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0339. Transform this scaled sketch into a three-dimensional model by rotating it with the same Euler angles and translating it with the same vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.03393665158371041 units, a width of 0.03393665158371041 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0339, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0339, 0.0339) \
     .lineTo(0.0319, 0.0339) \
     .lineTo(0.0319, 0.002) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.002) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are -90.0, 0.0, -90.0, which corresponds to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
# The translation vector is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], so no translation is needed
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.7500   # length along X
A = 0.0339   # leg size in Y
B = 0.0339   # leg size in Z
t = 0.0085   # wall thickness

# L-shaped angle profile drawn in the YZ plane, extruded along X
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(A, 0.0)
    .lineTo(A, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, B)
    .lineTo(0.0, B)
    .close()
    .extrude(L)
)

import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped angle bar: cross-section is an L profile (0.0339 x 0.0339),
# extruded 0.75 along X.
L = 0.0339   # leg outer size (Y and Z)
t = 0.005    # wall thickness of the angle
length = 0.75  # length along X

# Sketch the L cross-section on the YZ plane
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(L, 0)
    .lineTo(L, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, L)
    .lineTo(0, L)
    .close()
    .extrude(length)
)
